settings.title: Water-Free Technology.
settings.content: Unlike traditional diffusers, scentech uses cutting-edge nebulizing technology to deliver pure, undiluted fragrance. This ensures a consistent, long-lasting scent without the need for water or heat.

settings.title: Elegant Design.
settings.content: Its sleek, modern design fits seamlessly into any home decor, adding a touch of sophistication to your living space.

settings.title: The future of home fragrances is here.
settings.content:
At scentech, we believe your home deserves more than just a scent – it deserves an experience. That’s why we’ve combined advanced nebulizing technology with luxurious, long-lasting fragrance oils to bring a touch of elegance to your daily life.

Our subscription makes it easy to fill your home with signature scents designed to enhance your mood. From calming lavender notes to complex fragrances inspired by luxury hotels.

settings.title: How does the subscription work?
settings.content: With our subscription, you'll receive a 50ml fragrance oil pod each month, and a free scentech diffuser with your first order. You can easily switch scents each month through your personal dashboard.

settings.title: Is there a minimum subscription period?
settings.content: Yes, the minimum subscription period is 3 months. After 3 months, you can cancel anytime.

settings.title: Can I pause my subscription?
settings.content: Yes, you can pause your subscription at any time through your personal account dashboard. Simply choose the pause option, and you won't receive or be charged for that month.

settings.title: What if I don't like the scent I chose?
settings.content: If you don’t like a scent, you can always switch to a different fragrance for the next month. Additionally, feel free to take our scent quiz for personalized recommendations.

settings.title: How do I change my scent selections?
settings.content: You can adjust your scent preferences through our app or website before your next shipment.

settings.title: How long does each 50ml fragrance pod last?
settings.content: Each 50ml pod is designed to last for one month of intensive use.

settings.title: Is the diffuser covered by a warranty?
settings.content: Yes, the scentech diffuser comes with a life-time warranty, covering any manufacturing defects. If it breaks, you'll get a new one in a matter of days.

settings.title: Do I have to return the diffuser if I cancel my subscription?
settings.content: Yes, if you cancel your subscription you need to return the diffuser to us using our hassle free returns portal.

settings.title: How do I adjust the scent intensity and schedule?
settings.content: You can easily control the scent intensity and schedule through the app, allowing you to customize your experience to fit your lifestyle.

settings.title: Can I use other essential oils with the scentech diffuser?
settings.content: For the best performance and longest-lasting scent, we recommend using only scentech fragrance pods, which are specifically designed for our diffuser's technology. If you use other oils, the machine can get clogged due to different oil concentrations.

settings.title: How long does it take to receive my first order?
settings.content: Your first order, including the free scentech diffuser, will typically arrive the day after you ordered.

settings.title: How do I clean the diffuser?
settings.content: The scentech diffuser is designed to be low-maintenance. To clean, simply wipe down the exterior with a damp cloth, and run a cleaning solution through the diffuser once a month for optimal performance.
